items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: My father and his friends. And they organized a band and named it the Excelsior Band, you see.

ctx.x: And this is in Mobile, of course. What is your address here? 502 South Dearborn Street. And I wanted to ask when you were born, just the date.

1883, November 23rd. So you're 76 years old. 76 years old, this year. Now, as I'm saying, the Excelsior Band was practically born, you understand, on the day that I was born. And I was getting together. My father and his friends. And they organized a band and named it the Excelsior Band, you see.
Why did they choose Excelsior as a name? I don't know. But it was in honor of your birth. That's right.
